arxiv-2011-11978.description: Abstract We study the initial evolution of the coffee ring that is formed by the evaporation of a thin, axisymmetric, surface tension-dominated droplet containing a dilute solute. When the solutal Péclet number is large, we show that diffusion close to the droplet contact line controls the coffee-ring structure in the initial stages of evaporation.

arxiv-2203-00500.title: Refined Pinsker’s and reverse Pinsker’s inequalities for probability distributions of different dimensions
arxiv-2203-00500.creator: MICHELE CAPRIO 1
arxiv-2203-00500.description: Abstract We provide optimal lower and upper bounds for the augmented Kullback-Leibler divergence in terms of the augmented total variation distance between two probability measures defined on two Euclidean spaces having different dimensions. We call them refined Pinsker’s and reverse Pinsker’s inequalities, respectively. † † history: Date of publication xxxx 00, 0000, date of current version xxxx 00, 0000.

arxiv-2203-16507.title: AdaMixer: A Fast-Converging Query-Based Object Detector
arxiv-2203-16507.creator: Ziteng Gao, Limin Wang, Bing Han, Sheng Guo
arxiv-2203-16507.description: Abstract Traditional object detectors employ the dense paradigm of scanning over locations and scales in an image. The recent query-based object detectors break this convention by decoding image features with a set of learnable queries. However, this paradigm still suffers from slow convergence, limited performance, and design complexity of extra networks between backbone and decoder.

arxiv-2209-07640.title: Haptic Feedback Relocation from the Fingertips to the Wrist for Two-Finger Manipulation in Virtual Reality
arxiv-2209-07640.creator: Jasmin E. Palmer, Mine Sarac, Aaron A. Garza, Allison M. Okamura
arxiv-2209-07640.description: Abstract Relocation of haptic feedback from the fingertips to the wrist has been considered as a way to enable haptic interaction with mixed reality virtual environments while leaving the fingers free for other tasks. We present a pair of wrist-worn tactile haptic devices and a virtual environment to study how various mappings between fingers and tactors affect task performance.

arxiv-2303-13651.title: Building artificial neural circuits for domain-general cognition: a primer on brain-inspired systems-level architecture Thanks: This manuscript is part of the AAAI 2023 Spring Symposium on the Evaluation and Design of Generalist Systems (EDGeS)
arxiv-2303-13651.creator: Jascha Achterberg, Danyal Akarca, Moataz Assem, Moritz Heimbach, Duncan E. Astle, John Duncan
arxiv-2303-13651.description: Abstract There is a concerted effort to build domain-general artificial intelligence in the form of universal neural network models with sufficient computational flexibility to solve a wide variety of cognitive tasks but without requiring fine-tuning on individual problem spaces and domains.

arxiv-2308-09026.title: LesionMix: A Lesion-Level Data Augmentation Method for Medical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2308-09026.creator: Berke Doga Basaran (✉), Weitong Zhang, Mengyun Qiao, Bernhard Kainz, Paul M. Matthews, Wenjia Bai
arxiv-2308-09026.description: Abstract Data augmentation has become a de facto component of deep learning-based medical image segmentation methods. Most data augmentation techniques used in medical imaging focus on spatial and intensity transformations to improve the diversity of training images. They are often designed at the image level, augmenting the full image, and do not pay attention to specific abnormalities within the image.

pmc-12398150.title: Psychosocial moderators of the effect of lifestyle interventions in primary prevention of cardiovascular disease: a scoping review
pmc-12398150.creator: John Andersson, Melony Fortuin De Smidt, Anna E Sundström, Steven Nordin, Patrik Wennberg, Ulf Näslund
pmc-12398150.description: BackgroundLifestyle modification plays a key role in prevention of cardiovascular disease (CVD), but often fails due to non-adherence to lifestyle recommendations. Previous research has highlighted the importance of psychosocial factors in non-adherence, though focused on secondary rather than primary prevention.

pmc-12411321.title: A practical guide to long-term field PAM chlorophyll fluorescence measurements: setup, installation, data processing with R package ‘LongTermPAM’ and interpretation
pmc-12411321.creator: Chao Zhang, Erhard E. Pfündel, Jon Atherton, Juho Aalto, Jia Bai, Toivo Pohja, Paulina A. Rajewicz, Albert Porcar-Castell
pmc-12411321.description: Pulse-amplitude modulated (PAM) chlorophyll fluorescence (ChlF) measurements provide a non-invasive method to study the regulation of the light reactions of photosynthesis in situ. PAM ChlF contributes also to the advancement of the interpretation of long-term observations of remotely sensed solar induced fluorescence by revealing the mechanistic connection between ChlF and photosynthetic function.

pmc-12468332.title: Wavelia Microwave Breast Imaging Phase#2 Clinical Investigation: Methodological Evolutions and Multidimensional Radiomics Analysis Towards Controlled Specificity
pmc-12468332.creator: Angie Fasoula, Giannis Papatrechas, Petros Arvanitis, Luc Duchesne, Julio Daniel Gil Cano, John O’Donnell, Sami Abd Elwahab, Michael Kerin
pmc-12468332.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryX-ray mammography has limited sensitivity in dense breasts. Supplemental screening and diagnostic imaging methods are required to support breast cancer diagnosis in young women, who are typically associated with high breast density, and other underdiagnosed cancer patient groups. Management of the increased rate of false positives associated with most of the supplemental breast cancer diagnosis imaging methods remains a challenge.

pmc-12473475.title: Physicochemical and Antimicrobial Evaluation of Bacterial Cellulose Derived from Spent Tea Waste
pmc-12473475.creator: Cem Gök, Arzum Işıtan, Massimo Bersani, Paolo Bettotti, Laura Pasquardini, Michele Fedrizzi, Davide D’Angelo, Havva Boyacıoğlu, Ahmet Koluman, Luis Alves
pmc-12473475.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Bacterial cellulose (BC) is a high-purity biopolymer with excellent physicochemical and mechanical properties, including high crystallinity, water absorption, biocompatibility, and structural tunability. However, its large-scale production is hindered by high substrate costs and limited sustainability. In this study, spent black tea waste was utilized as a low-cost and eco-friendly carbon source for BC synthesis by Komagataeibacter xylinus ATCC 53524 under varying initial pH conditions (4–9).

pmc-12477790.title: Toxicological Effects of Lufenuron on Antioxidant Defence in Grass Carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella)
pmc-12477790.creator: Maria Saeed Khan, Abdul Ghaffar, Qudrat Ullah, Muhammad Farooq, Habiba Jamil, Muhammad Israr, Ibrahm A Alhidary
pmc-12477790.description: Lufenuron, an acyl urea insecticide, is widely used in agriculture, but its ecotoxicological impact on freshwater fish remains poorly understood. The present study investigated the biochemical and antioxidant responses of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) following chronic exposure to sublethal concentrations of lufenuron (2–4 µg/L) for 33 days.

pmc-12537771.title: Dual role of Lyz2-positive myeloid cells in traumatic brain injury: acute anti-inflammatory effects vs. chronic neurological deterioration
pmc-12537771.creator: Hua-Zheng Yan, Yi-Wan Fang, Shi-Yu Zhou, Jian-Xiong Gao, Ming-Ming Bian, Yao-Mei Xu, Lin Zhang, Nan Zhang, He-Zuo Lü
pmc-12537771.description: IntroductionNeuroinflammation is a critical factor contributing to secondary brain injury following traumatic brain injury (TBI). This process engages diverse cell types within the central nervous system (CNS), including significant infiltration of myeloid lineage cells–primarily neutrophils and macrophages–during the acute and subacute phases of TBI. These myeloid-derived cells represent a major population that critically influences the development and progression of neuroinflammation.

pmc-12686378.title: Longitudinal Study of Changes in Fertility Awareness and Lifestyle Behaviors Among Men in Japan After Viewing an Educational Video Focused on Enhancing Sperm Quality
pmc-12686378.creator: Kaori Nakada-Nakagomi, Fumi Atogami
pmc-12686378.description: Lifestyle factors greatly affect fertility, making improving the fertility awareness of men an urgent matter. This study aimed to assess changes in fertility awareness and lifestyle behaviors among men after viewing a video focusing on sperm quality. The participants in this single-group, longitudinal study were employed men in their 20s and 30s without children.

pmc-12772543.title: Concept and practice in the use of high-dose eicosapentaenoic acid for cardiovascular disease prevention in hypertriglyceridaemia
pmc-12772543.creator: Guillaume Roger, Chris J Packard, Luis Masana, Ulrich Laufs, Alberico L Catapano, Philippe Gabriel Steg
pmc-12772543.description: Genetic and epidemiological evidence indicates that triglyceride-rich lipoproteins are causal risk factors for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). Elevated levels of plasma triglyceride are common in patients who are diabetic or obese and contribute substantially to residual, ongoing risk of an ASCVD event in individuals on low-density lipoprotein (LDL)-lowering treatment. Hypertriglyceridaemia, therefore, presents a target for further intervention.

pmc-12848091.title: HIV case management using agent-based modeling approach subject to antiretroviral therapy and lifestyle treatment plan
pmc-12848091.creator: Akintayo Emmanuel Akinsunmade, Anthony Azagbaekwue, Friday Gabriel Emunefe, Oluwaseun Biodun Onuoha, Mario Raso
pmc-12848091.description: This study presents a spatially explicit stochastic agent-based model (ABM) to simulate the complex non-linear interactions between T-cells, HIV virions, and therapeutic agents. The model framework operates on a two-dimensional grid, explicitly modeling biological entities as discrete agents to investigate the effects of antiretroviral drug therapy and specific lifestyle interventions.

pmc-13235377.title: Optimization of ultrasonic-assisted extraction of total saponins from Semen Ziziphi Spinosae and evaluation of their antioxidant activity and pH stability
pmc-13235377.creator: Xuxu Zhang, Yuxian Shi, Jue Wang, Shuying Huo, Yuqing Yang, Xuejing Wang, Yurong Li
pmc-13235377.description: This study aimed to optimize the ultrasonic-assisted extraction (UAE) process for Semen Ziziphi Spinosae total saponin (SZS-TS) from defatted Semen Ziziphi Spinosae powder and to assess the antioxidant activity and pH stability of the SZS-TS obtained under these conditions. Single-factor experiments, along with a four-factor, three-level Box-Behnken response surface methodology, were utilized to optimize the UAE process parameters.

pmc-13273869.title: Delayed-onset portopulmonary hypertension following liver transplantation with near hemodynamic normalization on triple therapy
pmc-13273869.creator: Maie Abdullah, Stephen Roche, John Mwangi, Liam Arnold
pmc-13273869.description: Portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH) is a distinct subtype of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) occurring in the setting of portal hypertension. Although liver transplantation (LT) may relieve portal pressure, pulmonary vascular remodeling can persist or, rarely, develop de novo after transplantation, posing diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.Delayed-onset PoPH after LT remains poorly characterized, with limited data to guide recognition and management.

pmc-13662834.title: Dynamic Co‐Evolution of C‐Reactive Protein and Albumin in Early Sepsis: A Group‐Based Dual‐Trajectory Analysis for Risk Stratification
pmc-13662834.creator: Tengfei Chen, Shuwen Zhang, Maoyu Ding, Yumei Yang, Qinxiang Yang, Wei Guo, Xiaolong Xu, Qingquan Liu
pmc-13662834.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The coupled evolution of inflammation and metabolic dysfunction during early sepsis is incompletely characterized. Although C‐reactive protein (CRP) and albumin (ALB) are established markers of these processes, their joint longitudinal patterns have rarely been examined. We used group‐based dual‐trajectory modelling (GBDTM) to identify distinct coevolutionary patterns of CRP and ALB and to evaluate their associations with mortality in patients with sepsis.

pmc-13689059.title: Comparison of the effects of aquatic HIIT and MICT on central hemodynamics, endothelial function, and aerobic fitness in obese school-aged children: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13689059.creator: Junhao Huang, Weiwei Huang, Yongpeng Zheng, Weishan Lu, Shen Wang, Min Hu
pmc-13689059.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026).
